messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "heart problems, heart disease, heart defects, high blood pressure, family history of sudden death or heart problems"
set: ["heart problems, heart disease, heart defects, high blood pressure, family history of sudden death or heart problems", "in people with high blood pressure, heart disease, or a heart defect", "family history of heart disease", "heart problems or high blood pressure", "heart failure or other heart problems", "history of heart attack", "family history of sudden death", "heart", "other heart problems", "tell doctor if ever had heart disease, congestive heart failure", "dangerous heart rhythm problems", "heart problem", "heart disease", "heart failure", "heart rhythm", "heart effects"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
